context_title: When the website opens, a black background displays a blue and green aurora effect, but the colors do not overly dominate the black background. These colors continuously and very slowly flow. Suddenly, the green color completely fades out of the screen, and pink flows in. Later, the blue color fades out, replaced by a deep violet purple. Then, the pink suddenly fades out, and blue flows back in. Finally, the purple fades out, and green flows back in.
